# Tool and route map

<!-- Generated by node scripts/docs/check.mjs --write from the Node Skill. -->

This discovery map is derived from the [maintained Node Skill](https://github.com/OriginTrail/dkg/blob/testnet-canary/packages/cli/skills/dkg-node/SKILL.md). It reflects this source revision. Fetch the installed node's <code>/.well-known/skill.md</code> and inspect your runtime's tool schemas before calling an operation. Tool availability and camelCase/snake_case parameters differ by runtime; the table is not an OpenAPI schema or a universal MCP tool list.

| Tool | Wraps |
|---|---|
| `dkg_status` | `GET /api/status` |
| `dkg_wallet_balances` | `GET /api/wallets/balances` |
| `dkg_list_context_graphs` | `GET /api/context-graph/list` |
| `dkg_context_graph_create` | `POST /api/context-graph/create` |
| `dkg_subscribe` | `POST /api/context-graph/subscribe` |
| `dkg_context_graph_invite` | `POST /api/context-graph/invite` |
| `dkg_participant_add` | `POST /api/context-graph/{id}/add-participant` |
| `dkg_participant_remove` | `POST /api/context-graph/{id}/remove-participant` |
| `dkg_participant_list` | `GET /api/context-graph/{id}/participants` |
| `dkg_join_request_list` | `GET /api/context-graph/{id}/join-requests` |
| `dkg_join_request_approve` | `POST /api/context-graph/{id}/approve-join` |
| `dkg_join_request_reject` | `POST /api/context-graph/{id}/reject-join` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_create` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_write` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/write` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_finalize` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/finalize` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_share` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/swm/share` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_publish` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/vm/publish` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_pull_from` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/pull-from` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_discard` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/discard` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_import_file` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/import-file` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_query` | `GET /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/wm/quads` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_history` | `GET /api/knowledge-assets/{name}` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_import_artifact_read_markdown` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/import-artifact/read-markdown` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_import_artifact_resolve` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/import-artifact/resolve` |
| `dkg_knowledge_asset_semantic_enrichment_write` | `POST /api/knowledge-assets/semantic-enrichment/write` |
| `dkg_sub_graph_create` | `POST /api/sub-graph/create` |
| `dkg_sub_graph_list` | `GET /api/sub-graph/list` |
| `dkg_query` | `POST /api/query` |
| `dkg_query_catalog_list` | `POST /api/profile/query-catalog/read` |
| `dkg_query_catalog_run` | `POST /api/profile/query-catalog/read` + `POST /api/query` |
| `dkg_query_catalog_save` | `POST /api/profile/query-catalog/write` |
| `dkg_find_agents` | `GET /api/agents` |
| `dkg_send_message` | `POST /api/chat` |
| `dkg_read_messages` | `GET /api/messages` |
| `dkg_invoke_skill` | `POST /api/invoke-skill` |

For complete inputs, response handling, authentication, and async recovery, use [the HTTP application guide](../build/http-application.md), [API reference](api.md), and [Node Skill](node-skill.md).
